inputs.locator: Decision feature: DAILY_DOWNSIDE_SEMIVARIANCE_SHARE_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN. For each complete UTC day, sum squared negative hourly close-to-close returns and divide by the sum of all squared hourly close-to-close returns; divide that share by the median of exactly the prior 20 complete-day shares. At the unchanged DRA decision, admit only when the ratio is at or below the frozen threshold. No incomplete day, later bar, total-volatility substitution, sign change, alternate lookback or threshold search is permitted.

Frozen variants and accounting: lower neighbor 0.8, primary 1.0 and upper neighbor 1.2; Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and annual folds 2020-2024. Parent and every variant use 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity, eight 30-USDT lots, 0.10 percent fee each side, 0.05 percent adverse slippage each side, next-open fills, unchanged DRA seven-day cooldown and profit-only exits.

Frozen gate set: require exact corpus and parent parity; primary Design and Validation total PnL strictly higher; Validation realized and unrealized non-worse; Validation drawdown delta at most +0.25pp; median and P90 holding non-worse; at least four Validation interventions; at least 3/5 annual total-PnL wins and 4/5 annual drawdown non-worse; positive annual delta concentration at most 60 percent; both neighbors improve Validation total PnL, stay within drawdown tolerance and have adequate support. Every gate must pass.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen downside-semivariance DRA V1 entry-admission mechanism on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the unchanged equal-capital parent with primary 1.0 and the already frozen 0.8/1.2 stability neighbors. The decision feature uses only the latest complete UTC day's share of squared negative hourly returns in total squared hourly returns, divided by the prior 20-complete-day median. Retain one prior for a separately frozen hypothesis only if Design, Validation, annual breadth, contribution concentration, drawdown, holding, underwater duration, utilization, realized/unrealized PnL and terminal inventory pass the unchanged declarative gate set; otherwise close the family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not clean OOS, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: A long-only reversal accumulator can mistake a downside-dominated intraday path for a completed reversal. The sign-aware downside-semivariance share distinguishes days whose realized variation is concentrated in negative hourly moves from equally volatile but balanced paths before the unchanged next-open fill.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one post-hoc pre-2025 historical mechanism conclusion for exact same-equity DRA V1 with versus without DAILY_DOWNSIDE_SEMIVARIANCE_SHARE_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN admission. Historical Validation is not clean OOS. A positive result retains a prior for at most one separately frozen hypothesis; it is not independent alpha, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization. The task cannot inspect post-2024 outcomes, change a threshold, lookback, formula, runner or gate, create a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy or mutate canonical state.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The feature is valuable only if it avoids downside-heavy false reversals without merely suppressing participation or moving losses into terminal inventory. The frozen equal-capital screen therefore requires PnL breadth, drawdown non-inferiority, holding tails, underwater duration, utilization, realized-lot support and neighbor stability together.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The veto can miss profitable capitulation reversals, and the hourly estimator can be too coarse to separate downside risk. One frozen screen either retains the mechanism for one future hypothesis or closes it before new adapter, forward-source or OOS work consumes research capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Under identical 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity and unchanged DRA V1 economics, admitting signals only when the latest complete day's downside-semivariance-share ratio is at or below 1.0 will improve fee-adjusted total PnL in Design and historical Validation while preserving realized and unrealized components and maintaining acceptable drawdown, holding, underwater, annual-breadth and concentration paths.

decision_time.availability_rule: At each unchanged DRA complete-UTC-day decision, all 24 hourly closes for the just-completed day and every value in the prior 20-complete-day median are known before the next-open fill; no incomplete day or later return is used.

Compute hourly close-to-close returns without using a later bar.
